speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are presenting with a breast mass; to determine the cause, please describe exactly what you feel, including its size, texture, and whether it moves when you touch it. Additionally, do you have any nipple discharge or skin changes like dimpling or redness?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning, given the rapid growth over just four weeks. Is the mass hard and irregular, or is it soft and round? Do you have any enlarged lymph nodes in your armpit, and has the skin over the mass changed or become warm to the touch? REQUEST TEST: Mammogram and Bilateral Ultrasound.

OBSERVATION_ATTACK.clean_observation: RESULTS: Mammography: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast. Biopsy: Microscopic description shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth. Physical Exam: 6-cm, nontender, multinodular mass in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast; no palpable axillary or cervical lymphadenopathy; no skin changes.
